definition: שַׁעַטְנֵז noun masculine mixed stuff (perhaps of Egyptian origin; Kn derives from Coptic saht, woven, + nudj, false (Peyron Lex 224. 133 ), and thinks originally שַׁעַטְנֹז ; ᵐ5 has κίβδηλος spurious ); — a kind of cloth forbidden for garments; defined Deut 22:11 by צֶמֶר וּפִשְׁתִּים יַחְדָּו , and Lev 19:19 ( H ) by כִּלְאַיִם . שֵׁעִיר see שֵׂעִיר .
